item.title: Lawmakers consider child care solutions as time runs short
item.description: Child care providers in Indiana are struggling to stay afloat due to cuts to the Child Care Development Fund, and state lawmakers are proposing tax credit bills to help, but providers are concerned that these bills will not provide enough direct funding to sustain their operations.

item.title: IU’s Curt Cignetti wins ‘Bear’ Bryant Coach of the Year award
item.description: Indiana University football head coach Curt Cignetti won the Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year award after leading the Hoosiers to their first national championship in program history with an undefeated 16-0 record.

item.title: IU QB Fernando Mendoza draws crowd to sign autographs at store
item.description: Indiana University's Heisman-winning quarterback Fernando Mendoza drew a large crowd of fans at Dick's Sporting Goods in Bloomington to sign autographs and celebrate the team's perfect season and its victory in the College Football Playoff National Championship.

item.title: Shelbyville Common Council delays annexation for data center project
item.description: The Shelbyville Common Council has delayed the annexation of land tied to a data center project. Thousands of residents have expressed environmental and health concerns.

item.title: Body found in burning car in Delaware County ID’d as Shelbyville man
item.description: Five arrests have been made in connection to the death of Michael D. Greer, 54, who was found in a burning vehicle in Delaware County in mid-December, the sheriff says. The four suspects from Indianapolis were charged with murder.

item.title: Winter storm watches issued for southern Indiana counties
item.description: A winter storm is expected to impact Indiana this weekend, with snow and other wintry precipitation beginning on Saturday afternoon and continuing into Sunday, potentially causing significant travel disruptions and frigid temperatures.
